name.id: Panduan Membuat Website Pertama Kamu Live dari 0
name.en: Your First Website Live from Zero

description.id: Course step-by-step untuk membangun dan mempublikasikan website pertama kamu dari nol sampai live.
description.en: A step-by-step course to build and publish your first website from zero to live.

description.id: Membangun website untuk kebutuhan personal, bisnis, atau digital product.
description.en: Building websites for personal, business, or digital product needs.

description.id: Pengelolaan digital ads end-to-end: fondasi akun, tracking, campaign, creative direction, optimasi, reporting, dan business insight.
description.en: End-to-end digital ads management covering account foundations, tracking, campaigns, creative direction, optimization, reporting, and business insight.

promo.id: Fee dikonfirmasi setelah scope, platform, budget, dan kebutuhan pengelolaan disepakati.
promo.en: Fee is confirmed after the scope, platform, budget, and management needs are agreed.

description.id: Diskusi 1 on 1 selama 1 jam seputar digital marketing, lewat video call atau chat WhatsApp, dijawab dari pengalaman hands-on.
description.en: A one-hour 1 on 1 conversation about digital marketing, by video call or WhatsApp chat, answered from hands-on experience.

promo.id: Harga hanya tampil di halaman produk. Topik dan jadwal disepakati via WhatsApp sebelum pembayaran.
promo.en: The price is shown on the product page only. Topic and time are agreed on WhatsApp before payment.

description.id: Live test untuk mencoba flow pembelian Digital Marketing eBooks. Produk final dan eBook sungguhan belum tersedia.
description.en: A live test of the Digital Marketing eBooks purchase flow. The final product and actual eBook are not available yet.

description.id: Pendampingan untuk membantu kamu memahami dan membangun website sendiri, dari perencanaan sampai launch.
description.en: 1 on 1 guidance to help you understand and build your own website, from planning through launch.

description.id: Pendampingan praktis untuk memahami setup, campaign structure, creative testing, dan optimization di Meta Ads.
description.en: Practical guidance to understand setup, campaign structure, creative testing, and optimization in Meta Ads.

description.id: Pendampingan untuk memahami dan menjalankan Google Ads, termasuk Search, campaign setup, dan optimization.
description.en: Guidance to understand and run Google Ads, including Search, campaign setup, and optimization.

description.id: Template praktis untuk membantu monitoring, review, dan reporting performance marketing dengan lebih terstruktur.
description.en: Practical templates to support more structured monitoring, review, and performance marketing reporting.

description.id: Pemasangan event tracking dan conversion measurement agar aktivitas digital marketing dapat diukur dan dioptimasi lebih baik.
description.en: Implementation of event tracking and conversion measurement so digital marketing activities can be measured and optimized more effectively.
